scoring_justification: The PCF and pDOS checks verify re-derivable structural properties (disappearance of long-range peaks, peak merging) without recomputing absolute metrics, and the amorphization status is exact-match. T1 recompute of the full DFT-MD is not feasible in the lightweight checker environment.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: LiSi, Li1.71Si, Li3.25Si amorphize (true), Li3.75Si remains crystalline (false) under N_e=2 at 300 K.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: this is the paper's reported result, not fabricated.

hidden_assets.purpose: PCF structural thresholds: rmsd from 1.0 beyond 6 Å

hidden_assets.generation_method: set empirically from synthetic data matching the paper's qualitative behavior
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: thresholds are set to separate expected ordered vs. disordered states as described in the paper; verified against oracle data.

hidden_assets.purpose: pDOS structural thresholds: peak count and separation

hidden_assets.generation_method: peak detection logic modeled after the paper's qualitative claim
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: based on the paper's explicit statement and oracle-generated data that reproduces that statement.

outputs.description: Pair correlation function blocks for Li1.71Si at N_e=2; checker verifies disappearance of sharp peaks beyond 6 Å in later time steps.
Projected density of states on Si 3s/3p orbitals at t=0 and t=2.5 ps for Li1.71Si at N_e=2; checker verifies peak merging upon amorphization.
Amorphization status of the four alloys under N_e=2 at 300 K; checker validates boolean assignments against the expected amorphization pattern.

output_contract.notes: Scoring uses T3 structural checks: PCF long-range order loss, PDOS peak merging, and exact amorphization status pattern.

steps.description: Check long-range order disappearance in PCF beyond 6 Å: at 40 fs sharp peaks exist, at 140 and 2500 fs g(r)≈1.
Check initial pDOS has multi-peak features and final pDOS merges into single broad peak.
Amorphization status must match expected pattern.
